blocks.html: Best Metal Detectors 2026: Which Minelab is Right for You?

It’s a new year, and the metal detecting landscape has shifted. The biggest news for 2026? The legendary Vanquish series has finally gone waterproof with the new 60 Series, changing the game for beginners. But is it better than the X-Terra Elite? And is the Manticore still the king of depth?
We’ve compared the top 5 heavy hitters of 2026 to help you find the perfect fit for your budget and hunting style.
👇 Select a detector below to see our verdict:
The Game Changer: Minelab Vanquish 560
The Verdict: The new 2026 release that makes all other beginner machines obsolete. It finally combines Multi-IQ performance with a fully waterproof body.
Best For: Beginners & Beach Hunters
Waterproof: Yes (5m)
Tech: Multi-IQ
Why buy it? It eliminates the need to choose between performance and durability. You get rechargeable batteries, a flashlight, and salt-water capabilities in an entry-level package.
Plus you have a wide search coil choice, the Vanquish 60 series will work with X-Terra search coils and the Equinox search Coils.
